facts.business: Aarti Industries Limited is an Integrated Chemistry Solution Provider combining manufacturing excellence with digital innovation and sustainability, specializing in speciality chemicals.

segments.name: Manufacture of basic chemicals, fertiliser and nitrogen compounds, plastics and synthetic rubber in primary forms

auditor.name: Gokhale & Sathe, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualifications, reservations or adverse remarks or disclaimer made by the Auditor in their report.

key_risks: Geopolitical dynamics and evolving trade environment
Inflationary pressures and food/energy price volatility
Legacy tax litigations under Central Excise, Customs, Service Tax, Sales Tax and VAT
Income tax demands and transfer pricing adjustments
Regulatory compliance across multiple environmental and safety acts
facts.related_party_note: The Company has 11 subsidiaries, 2 joint ventures, and 6 enterprises/firms over which controlling individuals/KMPs have significant influence. Related party transactions include those with Aarti Corporate Services Limited, Nascent Chemical Industries Limited, Shanti Intermediates Private Limited, Innovative Envirocare Jhagadia Limited, Alchemie (Europe) Limited, Aarti Polychem Private Limited, Aarti Bharuch Limited, Aarti Circularity Limited, Augene Chemical Private Limited, Aarti Chemical Trading FZCO, Aarti Chemical Trading USA Inc., Augene Chemical Private Limited (JV), Re-Aarti Private Limited (JV), Alchemie Speciality Chemicals Private Limited, Alchemie Finechem Private Limited, Alchemie Gases & Chemicals Private Limited, Alchemie Dye Chem Private Limited, Aarti Drugs Limited, and Aarti Pharmalabs Limited.
